mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_rule_local_config ( rule_id, name, description, severity, check_interval_sec, action_interval_sec, conditions, filters ) VALUES ( #{ruleId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{severity}, #{checkIntervalSec}, #{actionIntervalSec}, #{conditions}, #{filters} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = #{name}, description = #{description}, severity = #{severity}, check_interval_sec = #{checkIntervalSec}, action_interval_sec = #{actionIntervalSec}, conditions = #{conditions}, filters = #{filters}
